exposure: MRI features of invasive placenta previa
cohort: The study included 138 women, comprising 45 with Placenta Percreta (PP) and 93 with Placenta Accreta (PA), who had all undergone 1.5T placental MRI.
finding: Placental bulge type-II and uterine serosal hypervascularity are useful MRI features for differentiating Placenta Percreta (PP) from Placenta Accreta (PA), with placental bulge type-II demonstrating the strongest independent association with PP.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, at the time of 1.5T placental MRI, specific gestational timing not specified.
